candidates.summary: the sibling address test isValidBech32Address still uses the loose bech32.Decode the diff replaced in CreateUsernameFromBech32
candidates.failure_scenario: The diff swept the class "decide whether a token is a gno address" from bech32.Decode to crypto.AddressFromBech32 (20-byte payload, hrp g) in handler_http.go:581, and missed the member at markdown/ext_mentions.go:49, which decides whether a realm-rendered token becomes a link to /u/<token> (ext_mentions.go:114, and the address branch at :97). mentionAddressPattern allows g1 plus 37 to 90 chars, so a token whose bech32 checksum is valid but whose payload is not 20 bytes still passes the loose test and is linked.
